about: Blainville is a suburban city in the Laurentides on Montréal’s North Shore, along Autoroute 15 between Sainte-Thérèse and Mirabel. It grew quickly from a seigneurial parish into a family-oriented commuter city of parks, sports facilities, and residential neighbourhoods. The old village and the Curé-Labelle corridor still mark the historic spine. About 60,000 people live in Blainville.
